verdict.rationale: Postman's own Agent Mode is documented to add and update tests on requests from natural-language instructions, which covers AI test generation for an endpoint. The docs don't say the tests are derived from an API spec or from observed responses, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Postbot appears only in usage-limit and licensing FAQs, not as a test generator. missing for 10: documented generation of tests/assertions from an OpenAPI spec or captured responses, details of the generated assertion types, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI generate test cases or assertions for an endpoint from its spec or responses

citations.quote: You can ask Agent Mode to add tests to requests, visualize responses, write documentation, and more.
Send requests, fix errors, update tests, and more, using natural language.
